jobs.title: Director of Demand Growth & Partnerships
jobs.description: We're looking for a performance marketing-driven leader who is equally comfortable discussing campaign performance, growth strategies, and client business objectives, while inspiring and coaching a team to deliver exceptional results. You are a natural relationship builder and trusted advisor, with strong negotiation and influencing skills that enable you to engage senior stakeholders, drive account growth, secure strategic partnerships, and create long-term value for both clients and the business. . This role is perfect for someone who enjoys building strong client partnerships, developing high-performing teams, and helping advertisers unlock new levels of growth through data, technology, and performance-driven strategies. What You'll Do Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Account Managers, fostering a high-performance and client-centric culture. Set clear goals, KPIs, and development plans for team members, ensuring alignment with company objectives. Negotiate commercial agreements, renewals, and account expansion opportunities. Own a portfolio of strategic demand-side accounts, with full responsibility for retention, growth, and client satisfaction. Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with client business objectives and company revenue goals. Identify and drive upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities across existing accounts. Lead regular business reviews and strategic planning sessions with clients to identify opportunities for increased investment and collaboration. Act as a trusted advisor, providing recommendations based on performance data, market trends, and industry best practices. Partner closely with Performance, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to ensure successful execution and delivery of client initiatives. Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging ad-tech solutions to bring innovative ideas to clients. Champion a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence. What We're Looking For 5–8+ years of experience leading Account Management, Client Success, Partnerships, or Growth teams within the Performance Marketing industry. High level of English proficiency, both written and verbal. Proven track record of growing existing client relationships and consistently driving upsell, cross-sell, and account expansion revenue. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with senior client stakeholders and act as a trusted strategic advisor. Strong commercial acumen with experience in negotiation, business development, and revenue growth. Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze performance metrics, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Who We Are At MediaForce, we thrive on collaboration, trust, and mutual support. As a fast-growing, global ad-tech company, we’re committed to a culture where every individual is valued and empowered to contribute — without the politics or endless approval chains. We believe in an open, innovative, performance-driven environment where ideas flourish and everyone can make an impact. If you’re looking for a place to grow, connect, and be part of a dynamic team, we’d love to meet you. Come be part of the force! Job Benefits Be part of a global team that’s talented, fun, and driven Work-life balance with our flexible hybrid working model Free gym membership conveniently located in our building Company events, team building, holiday celebrations, and happy hours Be part of something that matters — community support & volunteering initiatives

jobs.title: Junior Performance Growth Manager
jobs.description: Founded in 2007, MediaForce is a leader in online acquisition for the world’s largest brands. Using a proprietary AI powered media buying platform and in-house properties such as Comparisons.org and HealthyWallet, we have delivered millions of customers worldwide. About the Role: As a Growth Optimization Manager, you will take ownership of revenue optimization for our lead generation, content, and eCommerce business lines. With a growth-oriented mindset, you'll use audience insights and data to optimize landing pages, aiming to maximize revenue and surpass KPIs. Success in this role requires thriving in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities Data is at the heart of this job, but the numbers must be paired with creativity and marketing insights to fully understand target audiences and match these audiences with financial products. Job Responsibilities Project Management: Partner with cross-functional teams, including Paid Media, Product, Demand, and Creative teams, to create all A/B testing ideas from start to finish using Jira. Use Tableau for data analytics + engagement tools such as heat maps, user journey, and feedback surveys to analyze performance metrics and test data Lead Creative Ideation: Drive the creative ideation process, consistently generating innovative and high performing "big ideas" for paid media funnels for e-commerce and lead generation buys across social media and other platforms. Optimize Creative Coordination: Collaborate effectively with media buyers to manage funnel performance Help Develop Engaging Video Scripts: Help organize impactful direct-response video scripts for funnels. Use AI tools to support business optimization, generate and validate ideas, analyze data, and build AI-powered solutions and workflows that improve efficiency, testing, and revenue performance. Manage, analyze, optimize, and scale current landing pages to increase revenue and margin Ideate and implement tests, including copy, UI/UX changes, and offer orders to improve page metrics Identify trends across advertisers and/or platforms and use them to make recommendations Execute A/B tests, mostly focused on advertiser mix, content angle, offer depth, and page forma Job Requirements BA in Industrial Engineering and Management, Exact Sciences, Economics, Statistics, Psychology, or a related field. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to develop cross-department relationships and keep stakeholders informed of performance Analytical skills: a natural inclination to "follow the data" and make decisions and recommendations based on data - must have the ability to turn data into optimizations Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and a strong interest in leveraging AI for business needs, including building AI-powered workflows or solutions, automating processes, analyzing data, and improving business performance. Proficiency in Excel (Pivot Tables, Vlookup, etc.) and the ability to analyze large sets of data Strong project management and organizational skills to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment Who we are: At MediaForce, we’re a team that thrives on collaboration, trust, and mutual support. As a fast-growing, global ad-tech company, we’re committed to fostering a culture where every individual is valued and empowered to contribute—without the politics or endless approval chains. We believe in creating an open, innovative, and performance-driven environment where ideas can flourish, and everyone can make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can grow, connect, and be part of a dynamic team, we’d love to meet you. Come be part of the force! Job Benefits Be part of a global team that’s talented, fun, and driven. Enjoy a work-life balance with our flexible hybrid working model. Workplace perks like: Music room, gaming room, basketball room, ping pong, snooker, and spa. Free gym membership conveniently located in our building. Fun company events, team building, holiday celebrations, and happy hours Be part of something that matters - Community support & volunteering initiatives

jobs.title: Senior PPC Manager
jobs.description: Senior PPC Manager We’re looking for an experienced PPC specialist with deep expertise in Google Ads and a strong understanding of the comparison industry. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives on scale, testing, and measurable results. If you’re excited about building and optimizing large-scale campaigns, owning performance end-to-end, and working closely with creative and technical teams, this role is for you! What You’ll Own Google PPC Performance - Full ownership of Google Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube performance across multiple verticals, with a strong focus on ROI and lead quality. Campaign Execution & Optimization- Hands-on management of account structure, bidding strategies, keyword expansion, audience targeting, and ongoing optimization to drive profitable scale. Testing & Growth - Lead testing initiatives across creatives, landing pages, funnels, and bidding strategies. Turn insights into clear action plans. Data & Insights - Analyze performance daily, identify trends, and translate data into practical optimization steps in partnership with BI. Creative Collaboration - Work closely with the Creative Hub to improve ad messaging, formats, and funnel alignment for stronger performance. Team Contribution- Support and mentor junior PPC managers, share best practices, and help raise execution standards across the Google team. Platform & Partner Alignment - Maintain strong relationships with Google reps, stay on top of new features, betas, and industry changes. Requirements: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing international Google campaigns: Search, Display, DV360 and YouTube with monthly budgets exceeding 500k is a Set KPIs and ensure consistent achievement of performance targets. Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Up-to-date with the latest Google AdWords features and algorithm changes. Collaborate cross-functionally with business, product, content, and creative teams to ensure alignment and drive growth. Strong communication and collaboration skills Strong analytical skills, confident working with performance data, advanced level of Excel including data functions, pivot tables, macros. Experience integrating AI into marketing workflows. Who You Are You've managed large-scale accounts and consistently delivered results You want to build a performance machine, not just execute tasks You're obsessed with testing, iterating, and identifying what truly drives results You thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments You enjoy blending hands-on execution with strategic and technical development Use AI to work smarter and scale faster Passion for building and scaling campaigns from scratch An advantage: Experience with Bing and DV360. Experience with Google Analytics and reporting analysis. Familiarity with automation tools, scripts, and AI-driven marketing optimization. Who We Are At MediaForce, we thrive on collaboration, trust, and mutual support. As a fast-growing, global ad-tech company, we’re committed to a culture where every individual is valued and empowered to contribute — without the politics or endless approval chains. We believe in an open, innovative, performance-driven environment where ideas flourish and everyone can make an impact. If you’re looking for a place to grow, connect, and be part of a dynamic team, we’d love to meet you. Come be part of the force! Job Benefits Be part of a global team that’s talented, fun, and driven Work-life balance with our flexible hybrid working model Free gym membership conveniently located in our building Company events, team building, holiday celebrations, and happy hours Be part of something that matters — community support & volunteering initiatives
